learning_outcomes.text: Learn definitions, rules, pipe calculations, chimney and ventilation section calculations, and selection of other installation elements for project details related to gas appliances fed by natural gas distribution networks and placed inside buildings or plots.
Learn the basic principles in the construction of underground pipelines, pressure reduction and metering stations, and internal installations.
Grasp the functions of natural gas installation elements, become capable of sizing them, and draw plans and isometric views for projects.
Perform pipe diameter determination, chimney calculation, ventilation calculation, and selection of meters and other circuit elements.
Understand alternative systems where gas fuels can be used.
Perform design and project planning for different applications.

syllabus_topics: Topic, definition, scope, basic information about gas fuels
Definitions related to building internal installations
Rules for appliance placement, drawing plans and isometric schemes, details
Reinforcement of showing devices placed within rules on the plan and in isometric view
Natural gas installation calculation (21 mbar and building consumption value less than 31 m³/h systems), introduction of pipe diameter calculation chart
Calculation of continuous, local, and height difference pressure loss
Natural gas installation calculation (300 mbar and building consumption value greater than 31 m³/h systems), velocity control and dead volume calculation
Cathodic protection, grounding, strength and leak tightness tests
Functions and selection criteria of LNG, CNG (PNG) used facilities
Facilities where natural gas and LPG are used together
General evaluation of projects drawn starting from the second week
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated by combining coursework (Midterm Exam: 50%, Quiz: 30%, Homework: 20%) for 50% of the final grade, and the Final Exam for the remaining 50% of the final grade.
